:::{#def-normal}
#### Normal distribution (Gaussian distribution)

A random variable $X$ has the **normal distribution**
(or **Gaussian distribution**)
with mean parameter $\mean \in \reals$ and variance parameter $\ss > 0$,
written $X \sim \ndist{\mean, \ss}$
[@wikipedia_normal_distribution],
if $X$ is continuous with [density](#def-pdf):

$$\p(X=x) \eqdef \frac{1}{\sdpar\sqrt{2\pi}} \ef{-\frac{(x-\mean)^2}{2\ss}}, \quad x \in \reals$$

:::
